    Naming your Spiritmaster

    The Spiritmaster is Aion 2's summoner and controller. It commands spirits to pressure enemies and lock down the battlefield. The class fantasy is about bonds, pacts and elemental forces, so names that feel ethereal and otherworldly work best: soft openings like Ae-, Ori-, Eth- and Sel- with flowing endings like -ora, -yn and -iel.

    Try Oriyn, Ethora or Selaen for Elyos, or Nyroth and Terzoth for Asmodian. With the compound tone you'll get pact-themed names like Starwisp, Gloomcaller and Voidbond.

    Quick tips

    • Names that sound like they belong to the spirit world fit best: airy vowels, few hard stops.
    • Caller, pact, bond and wisp are great compound endings.
    • Some players name their character after the element they focus on.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is a good Spiritmaster name?

    Ethereal names such as Oriyn, Ethora, Selaen or Gloomcaller suit the summoner fantasy. Use the generator with class set to Spiritmaster for more.

    What does the Spiritmaster do in Aion 2?

    It is a summoner and controller class that commands spirits to pressure enemies and provide crowd control and utility.

    How do I use the Spiritmaster name generator?

    The class is already set to Spiritmaster. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
